---
name: pr-review
description: "Review GitHub pull requests and local branches with safe Git diffs, review artifacts, and optional approved comments. Use when reviewing a PR, current branch, or named branch; missing configuration or auth returns structured errors instead of exposing secrets."
---

Use the `pr-review` agent for analysis and reporting. Review code without edits
or commits. Write an artifact by default; post comments only when explicitly
requested for a pull request.
